name: SkillHurt
description: Calculates skill damage. Uses skill_dam_extra as the damage multiplier and skill_resist as the base resistance. NOTE: pierce/block (calArmorAndBlock) is called with double_hit_def as the attribute key instead of skill_resist — this may be a bug or intentional design.

parameters.usePierceResist: boolean, default true — whether to apply pierce/block

formula_steps.formula: ATK = attacker.att, DEF = defender.def, DEF_COE = defender.def_coe

formula_steps.description: Calculate base damage with defense coefficient
Apply pierce/block if enabled (uses double_hit_def attribute key for up_limit lookup)
formula_steps.formula: if (usePierceResist): resistance = calArmorAndBlock(defender, attacker, skill_resist, i.double_hit_def)
formula_steps.note: BUG/QUIRK: The attribute key passed is double_hit_def, not skill_resist. This means the up_limit cap is read from double_hit_def's config, and pierce/block probability triggers are based on the same armor_pen/block stats.

formula_steps.formula: dmg = roundInt(baseDmg * skill_dam_extra) * round(1 - resistance), dmg = roundInt(dmg)
if (crit_flag != 1): dmg = roundInt(dmg * max(1.5, round(crit_dam / crit_def)))

simplified_formula: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * skill_dam_extra * round(1 - pierce_block(skill_resist, key=double_hit_def))), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
